Montréal Communique 


May 20th, 1971. 


Secretary of State Gerard Pelletier will be a key 
participant in the YMCAs of Canada annual meeting to be 
held May 27-30 in Geneva Park, Ont. 

Policies and programs to directly influence about 
half a million Canadians will be hammered out by representatives 
from YMCAs in 76 different cities across the nation. 

The Y's efforts to become a more effective social 
force will be evaluated, and plans prepared for the next 
12 months. 

The Secretary of State, whose department has collaborated 
with the YMCA on a number of projects, will be keynote speaker 
at the annual meeting banquet on Saturday, May 29th, at 6:30 p.m. 

The 23-day gathering will be opened on May 27th, at 
9:00 p.m., by Rix G. Rogers, former Chief Executive of the 
Montreal YMCA, now serving as National Secretary of the 
YMCAs of Canada. 

Rogers will interpret the Y's multi-faceted drive 
to muster resources to meet urgent concerns of the day. 

Part of the agenda on Friday and Saturday will be 
taken up with discussions of special task force recommendations 
for changes in the Young Offenders' Act. 

Goals for the year ahead will be summarized by 
Holbrook R. Davis, Chief Employee Relations Officer of ALCAN 


Aluminium Ltd. Mr. Davis is President of the YMCAs of Canada. 


on Bn
